meaning: To write, record, prescribe, or decree.
details: Occurs in the Quran 319 times. Used in various forms including kataba (he wrote), kitab (book/script), and katib (writer).
verse: Surah Al-Baqarah (2:282) - 'O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down.'

meaning: To know, perceive, be acquainted with, or have knowledge.
details: Occurs in the Quran 854 times. Forms include 'alim (knower), 'ilm (knowledge), and ma'lum (known).
verse: Surah Al-Alaq (96:5) - 'Taught man that which he knew not.'

meaning: To show mercy, compassion, or loving-kindness.
details: Occurs in the Quran 339 times. Forms include Rahman (Most Merciful), Rahim (Especially Merciful), and rahmah (mercy).
verse: Surah Al-Fatihah (1:1) - 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.'

meaning: To guide, show the way, or lead to safety and truth.
details: Occurs in the Quran 316 times. Forms include hudan (guidance), yahtadu (they are guided), and hadi (guide).
verse: Surah Al-Baqarah (2:2) - 'This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah.'
